limits: Synthetic closed-mode corpus; no external acquisition.
Observed timings are not an SLA or pass/fail latency threshold.
Synthetic compute only; 120-second session budget includes five virtual seconds per request. No web speed claim.
Four workers can complete queries and bodies in different order; normalized observations per query compare filtering despite partial-session variation.
Baseline lacks quick configuration and relevant_only argument; after selects quick/120 and relevant_only=True. download_all=False in both.
All stages use actual Engine/NewsAcquirer/SQLite, fake fetcher only. Neutral fixtures never establish risk-free status.

Single-run timing is sensitive to shared-machine load; no performance threshold or percentage guarantee.
